timeline.tweet: Imma be honest... I saw 2 different videos today, and... now I just dunno anymore. I'm so confused... I don't understand what all the violence is supposed to achieve from BOTH cops and protesters. I don't wanna pick sides. I just want the times everyone was getting along back...

Agreed! It isn't just police brutality, though it is big, but I'm now seeing protesters turn into rioters and civilians running over others. It's not right. Don't let fear take innocent lives! #BlackLivesMatter

I know I've been super quiet about everything that's been happening, but there isn't much to really say that hasn't been said by so many, much better people than me. I support the #BlackLivesMatter movement. #ChangeStartsNow
